Account snapshot: mid-market CX SaaS that powers post-purchase support and knowledge-driven ticket deflection. Evaluating Redwood as replacement for current microservice-based LLM infra — goal is faster time-to-market and reduced ops.

POC summary: running hosted API POC for chat routing + embeddings since 2026-01-25. Baseline tests show latency ~180-220ms p95 for 512-token chat prompts on hosted. Embedding throughput target: 30k embeddings/day with batch windows. Demo showed good quality vs current smaller model.

Security/Compliance: CISO (A. Reyes) stated: "Need SOC2 Type II and an architecture that guarantees no cross-tenant leakage and clear audit trails." Primary asks:
- SSO: Okta SAML + SCIM for provisioning — MFA enforced.
- Audit logs: access + admin + model-inference logs exported to customer's SIEM via S3/pubsub; retention policy configurable to 1 year.
- KMS: customer-managed keys preferred; HSM option desirable for enterprise-sensitive flows.
- VPC: Private control plane option with VPC peering into our VPCs in us-east-1 and eu-west-1; must support CIDR restrictions and peering via Transit Gateway.
- Data residency: EU customers require eu-west-1 hosting for embeddings storage and retention controls.

Pricing & Capacity: Product/Finance want committed Dedicated pool pricing for predictable throughput (estimate 4 x A100-equivalent GPUs) with canary burst to handle marketing spikes. Suggested ARR band $40k-$120k depending on commit and retention SLA.

Open technical questions from Security review:
1) Where are inference logs stored by default and what fields are redacted?
2) Can audit logs be forwarded in real time to our Splunk instance? (we requested sample log schema)
3) SLA/latency guarantees for Dedicated nodes and fallback policies to hosted variants during maintenance.
4) Support timeline: SOC2 Type II evidence ETA and whether Redwood can provide ISO27001 scope doc.
